facts.fact: ICASEES states the Central African Republic adopted its second national statistics development strategy (SNDS2, period 2024-2028, envelope of nearly FCFA 60 billion) in August 2023.

ICASEES held a workshop on 7-9 October 2026 in Bangui, with members of the statistical programming committee (CTPAS), to review implementation of SNDS2 2024-2028 at mid-term against its commitments, funded by UNDP.

note: Mid-term evaluation workshop held 7-9 Oct 2026; the document lists outputs as expected and does not state the evaluation completed, so no evaluation fact.
